title: No way found to heal companion HP outside of combat. Brother Osk dropped to 3/8 hp around turn 260 (a lucky wolf hit) and stayed there for the rest of the 330-turn playthrough; 'rest by the fire'/'rest among the nets' and herb items only restored the player's own hp, never a companion's.
where: The Net-Hall / rest among the nets; wild herbs, dried herbs, bitter forest bark items
